requirements.title: MERGE admits TSOURCE of any type
requirements.definition: TSOURCE may be of any type.

pending.MERGE-TSOURCE-any-type-admitted: Use scalar integer, character with nondefault length, and a small derived-type pair as TSOURCE/FSOURCE positive controls; evaluate both MASK truth values and assert the selected value and type-specific sentinel fields. Mutate the intrinsic name to a type-specific alternative so the broad admission is load-bearing.

requirements.title: MERGE FSOURCE and MASK argument restrictions
requirements.definition: FSOURCE shall have the same type and type parameters as TSOURCE, and MASK shall be logical.

pending.MERGE-MASK-logical: Positive source controls use logical scalar and logical array MASK values containing both true and false; a source-control mutation uses an integer mask and claims no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: MERGE result type, parameters, and polymorphism follow the sources
requirements.definition: The MERGE result has the same type and type parameters as TSOURCE, and is polymorphic exactly for paired polymorphic TSOURCE and FSOURCE.

pending.MERGE-result-polymorphic-iff-both-source: Use an extensible parent type with two extended dynamic values passed through CLASS variables for both sources; assert SAME_TYPE_AS on the selected dynamic value for true and false MASK controls, then mutate one source to a nonpolymorphic declared variable in source review.

requirements.title: MERGE selects TSOURCE for true MASK and FSOURCE otherwise
requirements.definition: The MERGE result is TSOURCE for true MASK values and FSOURCE for false MASK values.

pending.MERGE-true-mask-selects-TSOURCE: Initialize an integer result to -777, evaluate MERGE(11,22,.TRUE.), and assert 11; mutate the MASK truth value so the assertion fails.
pending.MERGE-false-mask-selects-FSOURCE: Initialize an integer result to -777, evaluate MERGE(11,22,.FALSE.), and assert 22; mutate the MASK truth value so the assertion fails.
pending.MERGE-array-mask-elementwise-selection: Use TSOURCE=[1,2,3], FSOURCE=[10,20,30], MASK=[.TRUE.,.FALSE.,.TRUE.], initialize result to [-7,-7,-7], and assert [1,20,3]; mutate the operand order so the mixed mask detects the change.
